_comment: Who may assume the deploy role. Substitute ACCOUNT_ID, OWNER_ID and REPO_ID. Note the subject format: GitHub embeds immutable numeric ids as owner@id/repo@id. A policy written against the older repo:OWNER/REPO form silently never matches, and AWS reports only 'Not authorized' with no reason. Read the real value from a run rather than assuming: decode the id token's sub claim, see the git history of .github/workflows/ci.yml for a step that does it.
